meta.title: AtomCode Second Opinion
meta.description: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
